newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial buys $12.8 mln in property.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial buys $12.8 mln in property.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Friday it has acquired three fully-leased distribution warehouses comprising 537,453 square feet for $12.8 million.
All three properties, which were constructed within the last four years, are adjacent to Interstate 65 in Portland, Tenn., the company said.
First Industrial has the right to purchase future improvements on an adjacent 28.6 acres, it said.

"These strategic acquisitions compliment our existing portfolio and strong tenant base," said Michael Tomasz, president and chief executive of the real estate company. "The facilities were acquired below replacement cost and we anticipate yields in excess of 11 percent on total investment."
